title: About
tagline: Open source batch printing for Windows and Mac. No 15-file limit, no Adobe required, no $149 license fee.

available.title: Version {{version}} is available
available.verifiedNote: The download is checked against MaeclyPrint's release signature before anything is installed, and no administrator rights are needed.

updates.deferred: Reminder postponed. Check again whenever you like.
updates.skipped: Skipping {{version}}. A newer release will still be offered.

install.majorMessage: {{version}} is a major update from {{current}} and may change how MaeclyPrint works. If you rely on a particular workflow, read the release notes first.
install.restartDetail: Restart MaeclyPrint to start using it.
install.nothing: There is no installable update for this platform yet. Download it from the release page instead.
install.signatureInvalid: The downloaded update failed its signature check and was not installed. Nothing on this computer was changed. Try again later, or download the release from the release page.
install.failed: The update could not be installed: {{error}}

ipcUnavailable: IPC unavailable: {{error}}. This is expected when running the standalone Vite dev server (no Tauri host). Run {{command}} to test the real bridge.

footer.license: MaeclyPrint is free software licensed under {{license}}. No telemetry, no cloud, no account.
